newsitem.title: EU: EP Agriculture Committee agenda - June 17-18.
newsitem.headline: EP Agriculture Committee agenda - June 17-18.

text.p: Committee on Agriculture and Rural Development [[ Tuesday 17 June 1997 ]] PUBLIC MEETING 0.1 1. Adoption of draft agenda (PE222.487 ) 2. Approval of minutes of meeting of: - 12 May 1997 (PE222.482 ) ===] In the presence of the Commission 2.2 2.3 JOINT MEETING with the Council of Europe's Committee on Agriculture 2.4 3. Situation report by Mr FISCHLER, Member of the Commission, on the common agricultural policy 3.1 Statements by the Council of Europe rapporteurs (Bratislava Conference on rural development, world food supplies, etc.) 3.2 Statements by European Parliament rappoteurs (farm prices, quality of products, etc.) - Exchange of views ===] Wednesday 18 June at 9 a.m. 4. Ad hoc procedure for agricultural expenditure (T05408) BUD0087 + AGRI Avis A MULDER Jan. (ELD) (PE222.478 ) F BUDG Fond TILLICH Stanislaw. (PPE) - Adoption of draft opinion - Adoption of amendments Adoption of amendments to the preliminary draft budget 5. Common organization of the market in raw tobacco (T04460) COS0527 COM(96)0554 C4-0057/97 + AGRI Fond R ROSADO FERNANDES R. (UPE) (PE221.791 ) - Adoption of draft report 6. Seed marketing (beets, fodder, cereals, seed potatoes, etc.) (T03214) CNS0808 COM(93)0598 C3-0002/94 + AGRI Fond R GRAEFE ZU B. (V ) (PE213.276/DEF) - Adoption of compromise amendments 7. Common organization of the market in hops (T05434) CNS97066 COM(97)0098 C4-0184/97 + AGRI Fond R MAYER Xaver. (PPE) (PE222.480 ) - Consideration of draft report 8. Marketing and labelling of beef (repealing Regulation 2067/92/EEC) (T05464) CNS97058 COM(97)0070 C4-0193/97 + AGRI Fond R HARDSTAFF Veronica M (PSE) (PE222.484 ) - Consideration of draft report Possibly consideration of draft report 9. Labelling, presentation and advertising of foodstuffs (ingredients of alcoholic beverages)(Am. Dir. 79/112/EEC) (T05402) COD97027 COM(97)0020 C4-0059/97 + AGRI Avis A KLA3 Christa B. (PPE) F ENVI Fond R SCHNELLHARDT Horst. (PPE) - Exchange of views 10. Decision on procedure 11. Possibly appointment of rapporteurs and draftsmen - decisions on procedure 12. Any other business 13. Date of next meeting (in BRUSSELS) (PE/II/OJ/97-13 ) 13.1 13.2 N.B. A coordinators' meeting may be held during the meeting. - FIN - END OF DOCUMENT.
